name: LMTD Calculator - Log Mean Temperature Difference
description: Calculate Log Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) for heat exchanger design and analysis.

seo.title: LMTD Calculator - Heat Exchanger Design
seo.description: Calculate Log Mean Temperature Difference for counter-current and co-current (parallel) heat exchangers.

formula.explanation: LMTD = (ΔT1 − ΔT2) / ln(ΔT1/ΔT2). For counter-current: ΔT1 = Th_in − Tc_out, ΔT2 = Th_out − Tc_in. For equal ΔT at both ends, LMTD = ΔT.

content.introduction: LMTD represents the effective average temperature driving force in a heat exchanger. Used in Q = U·A·LMTD. For counter-current flow (preferred), ΔT is taken at each end. For parallel flow, both streams enter at the same end.

example.description: ΔT1 = 60°C, ΔT2 = 40°C → LMTD = 49.3 K (the arithmetic mean would be 50, very close when ΔT ratio < 2).

faq.q: When is LMTD correction factor F needed?
faq.a: For multi-pass shell-and-tube exchangers (1-2, 2-4 pass) or cross-flow, multiply LMTD by correction factor F (0.5-1.0) from TEMA charts based on P and R parameters.
The formula gives 0/0, but as ΔT1→ΔT2, LMTD→ΔT (the arithmetic mean). The calculator will handle this case by using ΔT directly.
